examples.coptic: ϧⲉⲛⲟⲩϭⲱⲗⲕ ⲕⲛⲁϭⲱⲗⲕ ⲛⲧⲉⲕⲫⲓϯ ϩⲓϫⲉⲛⲛⲓ**ϭⲏⲡⲓ** ⲇⲓⲁⲯⲁⲗⲙⲁ ⲉϥⲉⲫⲱϫⲓ ⲛϫⲉⲡⲕⲁϩⲓ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛϩⲁⲛⲓⲁⲣⲱⲟⲩ .
examples.english: Surely thou didst bend they bow at scepters, saith the Lord. Pause. The land of rivers shall be torn asunder.

examples.english: O every shower and dew, bless ye the Lord: praise and exalt him above all for ever.

examples.coptic: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲥϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲛϫⲉⲟⲩϭⲏⲡⲓ ⲉⲥⲉⲣϧⲏⲓⲃⲓ ⲉⲣⲱⲟⲩ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲁⲥϣⲱⲡⲓ ⲛϫⲉⲟⲩⲥⲙⲏ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛϯ**ϭⲏⲡⲓ** ϫⲉⲫⲁⲓ ⲡⲉ ⲡⲁϣⲏⲣⲓ ⲡⲁⲙⲉⲛⲣⲓⲧ ⲥⲱⲧⲉⲙ ⲛⲥⲱϥ .
examples.english: A cloud came, overshadowing them, and a voice came out of the cloud, 'This is my beloved Son. Listen to him.'

examples.english: “and why the north hath arisen. Yet further, O my disciples, hearken and continue to be sober and hearken to the total gnosis of the mystery of the Ineffable. “That mystery knoweth why the demons have arisen and why mankind hath arisen. “And that mystery knoweth why the heat hath arisen and why the pleasant air hath arisen. “And that mystery knoweth why the stars have arisen and why the clouds have arisen. | “And that mystery knoweth why the earth became deep and why the water came thereon. And that mystery knoweth why the earth became dry and why the water came thereon. And that mystery knoweth why famine hath arisen”

examples.coptic: ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲡⲁⲓⲣⲏϯ ⲁϯ**ϭⲏⲡⲓ** ϩⲱⲗ ⲛⲉⲙⲁϥ ⲁⲥⲉⲛϥ ⲉⲡⲉϥⲙⲟⲛⲥⲧⲏⲣⲓⲟⲛ .
examples.english: And with that, the cloud continued on its way and brought him safely home to his monastery.
